## 💡 Key Questions to Ask Any Consultant

When you meet with these firms, make sure to ask:

1. **Do you have experience with manufacturing clients?** (shop-floor data capture, production scheduling, quality checks)
2. **Which ERPs have you integrated with?** (SAP, MYOB, Business Central, Oracle, etc.)
3. **Can you show us a reference case of ERP-adjacent automation?**
4. **Do you support Power Automate Desktop (RPA) for legacy system integration?**
5. **What does your post-go-live support model look like?**
